display_name: Procopius of Jerusalem, son of Theodosia

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 iulie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Procopie», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Προκόπιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυς», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro sets the whole story under «Dioclețian, păgânul împărat al Romei» and dates only the day: «și-a pus sufletul pentru Domnul său, în 8 zile ale lunii lui iulie». The interval is Diocletian's reign; the page gives no year.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 iulie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Procopie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Προκόπιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives the same man: raised at Jerusalem under Diocletian, son of the devout Christopher and of the idolatrous Theodosia, whom the folder already keeps beside him. It heads him «(; - 303)». The same day's listing carries three further men of the name — the fool for Christ of Ustyug, the saint of Usya in Vologda, and «Άγιος Προκόπιος ο εφορκιστής», which carries the site's own asterisk and says in its own words that he is «άλλος συνώνυμος του μεγαλομάρτυρα Προκοπίου»; that one is refused and the first two are drafted as new folders. The page prints hymns, but the extractor cut it in the middle and no hymn was read whole, so none is taken.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Nu de la oameni, ci de la Dumnezeu primind chemare, sfinte, ai lăsat credinţa părintească cea rea şi slujbele cele orânduite; şi râvnind după Hristos, ca un al doilea Pavel, ai suferit multe osteneli şi răni. Şi primind acum cununa cea făgăduită, Mare Mucenice Procopie, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Procopie», Glasul 8

english.text: Receiving your calling not from men but from God, holy one, you left the bad faith of your fathers and the appointed services; and in zeal for Christ, like a second Paul, you endured many labours and wounds. Having now received the promised crown, Procopius, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.
